body: I am applying for the Accounts Payable / Receivable Accountant role in trivago's Operational Accounting team. I have spent five years in financial operations, most recently at BNP Paribas, where I checked and processed broker invoices every month for BGC/GFI, TP ICAP, Tradition and Bloomberg, reconciled the invoiced fees against internal trade records, and reconciled commission receivables and payables and cash against bank statements. What draws me to trivago is the move from a bank's shared-services centre into a company's own finance team, working in English and in a team that is openly bringing AI and automation into invoice matching and reconciliation.

Your posting asks for someone who reviews as much as prepares and improves how AP and AR work end to end. As key checker I reviewed my colleagues' reconciliations, wrote the team's SOPs and handled internal and external audit requests. I led the automation of our equity reconciliation, cutting handling time from eight hours to four, and introduced auto-matching rules that reduced manual effort by 30%. I already use AI tools in my own work, have worked with SAP and will get up to speed on Microsoft D365 quickly.

Hiring me needs no visa support. I already live in Germany and hold a Chancenkarte (§20a AufenthG): a concrete job offer is enough to begin converting it to unrestricted full-time authorisation, and until then the same law permits a two-week full-time trial (details enclosed). I am also building my German alongside my work. I can start in Düsseldorf at short notice.
I have attached my CV and a one-page overview of what hiring me involves, and I am available for the video interview at any time.
enclosures: CV · What hiring me costs you
footer: Chancenkarte holder — eligible for full-time work, no sponsorship required
